title: `merge --fix-check` records a fix check after a notes-only commit
why: Incident #1515 (coordinator, 15:03 CST): a fix check could not be recorded after a notes-only commit on the PR.
note: Red test first. Scope (lane, 15:04 CST): `merge --fix-check` in merge/merge.py may record a fix check when every commit after the newest earlier record's Head touches only record or notes files (the record kinds in lint/layout.json); any other later commit still refuses. Seen on lane verdict-pipe-masks-exit, PR #1515, 15:02 CST. Stacks on review-fix-check-round (#1440). Topic review-rounds. Notes from PR #1575's round-3 review (reviewer sonnet, 16:22 CST Nov 7), owed to docs/debts/notes.md, decision pr-review-record: (1) fix-check-reads-doc-drift: pr-review-record.md says --fix-check adds one paged read; it now adds up to two compare reads, and with --fix-base-record one comment read and one paged list; no test pins the count. (2) compare-files-missing-key-reads-clean: Host.compare_files in merge/merge.py reads a reply with ahead_by above 0 and no files key as record-only, so it fails open; whether GitHub omits that key is unmeasured; fix: refuse when the key is absent. Routed (coordinator, 16:22 CST): this lane fixes compare-files-missing-key-reads-clean, and records fix-check-reads-doc-drift as a note in the same PR.
